name: Keeper Bel'dugur
summary: In the Undercity, Keeper Bel'dugur commissions expeditions to recover dark tomes and magical artifacts for his people. The scholarly Forsaken works deep within the Apothecarium.

sections.title: A Collector of Dark Relics
sections.body: Among the Apothecarium's vats and researchers, Keeper Bel'dugur sends adventurers to recover dangerous arcane and occult relics from across Azeroth. The Book of Ur, a legendary treatise on extra-dimensional beings, is locked away inside Shadowfang Keep and draws his keen interest. While many in the Undercity seek magical knowledge to cure or weaponize undeath, Bel'dugur's curated acquisitions seem chosen to uncover ancient, forbidden powers.

sections.title: Hidden Loyalties
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur's calm manner as an Undercity researcher conceals his loyalty to the apocalyptic Twilight's Hammer cult. The assignments he gives quietly advance the cult's esoteric aims, seeking foundational grimoires of summoning and void magic beneath the unsuspecting eyes of the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas.

faq.q: Where can I find Keeper Bel'dugur?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur works in the Apothecarium, the alchemical district in the Undercity's southern lower ring.

faq.q: Why does Bel'dugur want The Book of Ur?
aliases: what does beldugur do with book of ur
faq.answer: The Book of Ur holds Dalaran mage Ur's foundational research on other dimensions and the feral worgen. Bel'dugur seeks its forbidden summoning principles for the dark schemes of his true masters.

faq.q: Is Keeper Bel'dugur loyal to Lady Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur outwardly serves the Forsaken as an archivist and researcher, though hints in his investigations suggest his loyalties may lie elsewhere.

faq.q: What other tasks does he give adventurers?
faq.answer: Beyond the Book of Ur in Shadowfang Keep, Bel'dugur sends travelers after forgotten lore and forbidden tomes, including dark treatises tied to ancient rituals and forbidden knowledge.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may see Bel'dugur as another scholarly Forsaken seeking forbidden knowledge to bolster your kingdom. His true ambitions serve a cause beyond the Banshee Queen's survivalist cause.
As a Warlock, you often cross paths with Bel'dugur's requests. His interests reach into dangerous grimoires, extraplanar summoning, and dark occultism.
